definition: Company profit for the period after expenses, exceptional items and tax. This is not a separate profit for each product group or brand.
location: Standalone statement of profit and loss · PDF page 61 (printed page 85) and Note 4 exceptional items · PDF page 67 of the annual report copy filed with BSE
notes: Amounts converted from ₹ million by dividing by 10. Revenue from operations includes sale of products and other operating revenue. Annual report Note 42 reports one Food operating segment; the cited disclosure does not give separate profits for the four product groups. Figures are historical annual results, not the latest quarter. One-off items sit inside this profit. Old income tax cases were closed, so provisions made in earlier years were written back, worth ₹312.04 crore in total: ₹202.32 crore is shown as an exceptional item and ₹109.72 crore as lower tax. Two one-off costs are also exceptional items: ₹40.10 crore of severance pay for a restructuring and ₹41.44 crore for the Labour Codes (new wage and labour rules in force from 21 November 2025), which raised what the company owes employees in retirement benefits for service already worked. Together these give a net exceptional credit of ₹120.78 crore. Exceptional items are unusual one-time gains or costs that a company shows on a separate line.
